styleSelection.reason: The reference is a pen-and-wash sketch of a sunlit southern French hillside village whose broad foliage and architectural washes require multi-lane physical mop and flat-brush sweeps across five value bands, paired with full opening and closing sepia-ink linework.

families.name: sunlit-stone-and-roofs
families.description: Sunlit warm stone facades, terrace walls, terracotta roofs, and sunlit earth paths across the upper terrace and lower-right village cluster

families.name: bright-canopy-lights
families.description: Sun-struck yellow-green deciduous crown in the lower-left foreground and bright olive crests catching direct sunlight

families.name: warm-olive-slopes
families.description: Warm light-middle olive and golden-green hillside foliage linking the upper terrace to the lower village

families.name: mid-olive-foliage
families.description: Main body of Mediterranean olive and scrub foliage across the diagonal hillside

families.name: shadow-foliage-masses
families.description: Cooler deep olive-green and umber shadow undersides within the trees, shrubs, and hillside hollows

families.name: cypress-and-distant-valley
families.description: Upright dark cypress spires, cast architectural shadows, window openings, foreground trunk crevices, and the cool blue-green distant valley at upper right

reserves.name: lower-village-sunlit-gable
reserves.reason: Brightest sunlit plaster highlight on the central tower facade in the lower-right village cluster

reserves.name: upper-terrace-parapet-light
reserves.reason: Sun-bleached stone coping highlight along the upper-left terrace wall
